bio: What a fabulous property! With this magnificent villa, Michael and Brigitta Quendler have opted for a highly distinguished setting in which to indulge their guests. Elegant style, warm tones, beautiful wooden floors, large mullioned windows – the overall effect is really inviting. Add to the location the attentive and competent service and Michael Quendler's cooking. Although predominantly a classic affair, his cuisine is still modern and enjoyably pared down – he is adept at weaving the different flavours of his excellent ingredients together, in dishes such as red prawn with mushrooms, leek and mango, or scallop with celery, apple and ponzu. There are two set menus (one of which is vegetarian/vegan) featuring dishes you can also combine as you please or order à la carte. Excellent select...
